scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:go && npm run stage
scripts.fpk:amd64: npm run build:icons && npm run build:frontend && cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 node scripts/build-go.js && node scripts/set-platform.js x86 && cross-env TARGET_ARCH=amd64 npm run stage && node scripts/fnpack.js build --directory package/diskbench
scripts.fpk:arm64: npm run build:icons && npm run build:frontend && cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 node scripts/build-go.js && node scripts/set-platform.js arm && cross-env TARGET_ARCH=arm64 npm run stage && node scripts/fnpack.js build --directory package/diskbench
scripts.serve: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:go && cross-env LOCAL_DEV=1 PORT=5050 FRONTEND_DIST=../frontend/dist DATA_DIR=../.local-data node scripts/run-backend.js
scripts.demo: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:go && cross-env LOCAL_DEV=1 MOCK_DEV=1 PORT=5050 FRONTEND_DIST=../frontend/dist DATA_DIR=../.local-data node scripts/run-backend.js
